name: Hardline: Meridian Crime Division
description: A prestige crime procedural in which viewers inhabit the perspective of rotating detectives within the Meridian 88 Civil Enforcement Bureau, solving corporate-adjacent homicides across Tiers 2 through 4. The show is technically independent but produced with HelixCorp infrastructure financing and consistently avoids storylines implicating Tier 5 actors. Its production values are extraordinary; its moral universe is carefully bounded.
cultural_impact: Hardline normalized the Civil Enforcement Bureau as a legitimate institution to Tier 2 audiences at a moment when CEB credibility was at a historic low following the 2211 Stack Raids.
story_hooks: The pulled Season 4 episodes exist as a complete cut; the terminated writer wants them broadcast and needs infrastructure help.

A character introduced in Season 4 is based on a real CEB officer who is now being quietly reassigned — the fictional version of events is closer to the truth than anyone in the Bureau is comfortable with.
Someone within the show's production is inserting micro-edits into the neural feed — brief flashes of real crime scene documentation spliced into fictional sequences.
